scientific_task: Two-dimensional nine-velocity BGK lattice Boltzmann flow
community_use_case: Controlled mesoscopic flow transport, obstacle bounceback and conservation checks across three Julia GPU abstractions; a reusable numerical operator/verification resource, not a validated turbulent-flow simulation.
mathematical_operation: Periodic pull streaming, positive conditional row forcing, density/momentum equilibrium, BGK relaxation, obstacle reversal and per128cell serial velocity/count reduction.
accuracy_requirements: Independent Float64 tensor moments/equilibrium and periodic streaming; both final time levels, all block sums/counts at every step, actual inputs/guards exact, positive populations and mass drift<2e-4.
